excerpt_i18n.en: Leifeng Network previously exclusively reported that Xia Zhongpu, former head of end-to-end autonomous driving at Li Auto, would transition to embodied AI. Last night, the general embodied AI company Wujie Dongli officially announced that Xia Zhongpu will serve as co-founder and co-CTO, responsible for the research and development of a native embodied AI multimodal large model based on world models. In the history of China's intelligent driving industry, Xia Zhongpu, the first to develop and mass-produce an end-to-end model, is an indispensable key figure. Precisely because of this, after talents from Li Auto's intelligent driving team, such as Lang Xianpeng and Jia Peng, entered the field of embodied AI, Xia Zhongpu's next move became one of the most closely watched mysteries in the intelligent driving circle, AI community, and primary market. His official joining also adds a new label to Wujie Dongli, which surfaced only half a year ago, making it the only general embodied AI team in the wave of transitioning from intelligent driving to embodied AI with a combined background of "Horizon Robotics + Li Auto." Another label comes from Zhang Yufeng, founder and CEO of Wujie Dongli. He is the only early employee at Horizon Robotics, aside from the three founding members, to join the company's board of directors and the EMT management committee. During his eight-year tenure, he grew Horizon Robotics' intelligent driving business from scratch to become the market leader in China. With AI perception technology rapidly advancing into outdoor applications, robotic lawn mowers are undergoing a critical transition from automated execution to autonomous decision-making. In the field of smart garden robotics, MOVA has pioneered the AI binocular vision robotic lawn mower ViAX series and achieved deep integration of 3D high-precision LiDAR with AI vision in its latest LiDAX Ultra AWD series. By introducing core perception technologies from the autonomous driving sector into garden scenarios, MOVA has developed a multi-sensor fusion system centered on AI vision, endowing robotic mowers with near-autonomous-driving-level environmental understanding and decision-making capabilities, marking the official entry of lawn mowers into the "era of autonomous decision-making."

World's First Binocular Vision AI Perception: Enabling Robotic Lawn Mowers to "Understand" the World  
MOVA has successfully adapted multi-sensor fusion technology and AI vision algorithms from autonomous driving to robotic lawn mowers. Equipped with dual 1080P HDR ultra-high-definition color cameras and its proprietary UltraEyes™ 1.0 AI binocular vision fusion system, the mowers utilize deep learning algorithms for real-time semantic segmentation and object recognition of captured images. The system accurately distinguishes between lawn and non-lawn areas, such as flower beds, pathways, and sandy patches, and can identify over 300 common garden obstacles, including pets, children, hoses, toys, and hedgehogs, ensuring operational safety at its core.

En el campo de los robots inteligentes para jardines, MOVA ha sido pionera en lanzar la serie ViAX de robots cortacésped con visión binocular de IA, y en su última serie LiDAX Ultra AWD ha logrado una integración profunda del lidar 3D de alta precisión con la visión de IA.
